text:
maria_se: Quick heads up — BlueWave procurement pinged for SIEM/logging evidence for their vendor risk review. They want sample audit events, retention numbers, and how we forward to their Splunk. POC starts Monday.

devon_sec: I'll assemble a minimal packet. Need to confirm current Hosted defaults and what we can promise in writing for the POC.

maria_se: Their security questionnaire has 3 fields: admin activity capture, log forwarding/format, and retention/immutability.

devon_sec: Draft mapping to SIG/CAIQ: admin/audit -> CAIQ.AUDIT-01; forwarding & monitoring -> SIG.MON-02; retention & immutable archive -> SIG.RET-03.

tyler_poc: If we push logs to their Splunk HEC, do we need any network allowlist details? Also they asked about compressed formats for long-term S3 export.

devon_sec: Network: we provide example egress IP ranges and require customer's HEC endpoint with TLS mutual auth if they want stricter controls. We also support TLS + HMAC token. Long-term export: gzipped ndjson to S3, can be encrypted with customer KMS.

maria_se: Can you paste 2 tiny example events (admin action + detection) so I can embed in the procurement response? Keep them short.

devon_sec: Sure. Admin action example:
```json
{"event_type":"admin_action","timestamp":"2025-11-02T09:12:01Z","actor":{"id":"u_88","email":"maria@redwood.com","role":"org_admin"},"action":"rotate_api_key","target":{"resource_type":"api_key","resource_id":"k_ab12"},"request_id":"req_555"}
```

devon_sec: Detection example (anomaly):
```json
{"event_type":"detection","timestamp":"2025-11-02T09:14:10Z","detection":"suspicious_batch_inference","severity":"medium","details":{"batch_size":1200,"threshold":1000},"related_request_ids":["req_556"]}
```

tyler_poc: Nice. Any recommended rsyslog/forwarder snippet? Their ops team is small.

devon_sec: Minimal forwarder (forward to Splunk HEC in TLS):
```bash
# forward audit logs to Splunk HEC
cat /var/log/redwood/audit.log | openssl s_client -quiet -connect splunk-hec.bluewave.local:8088 -ign_eof -crlf -quiet -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem
```

devon_sec: For production we recommend our managed forwarder (agent) which supports retries, backpressure, and batching; or direct S3 export for immutable archival.

maria_se: Retention defaults we usually state? They want explicit numbers in the questionnaire.

devon_sec: Hosted defaults (copy for questionnaire): API logs: 90 days hot, 13 months cold. Admin/audit: 1 year default; optional archival up to 7 years to customer S3 with Object Lock. Auth events: 13 months. Inference metrics: 90 days. Note: POC we can keep logs for 6 months by config.

maria_se: Good. Add one sentence about access controls and encryption.

devon_sec: "All logs are encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Access to audit logs is role-based; only SOC and org_admin roles have read/restore privileges and access is logged. Customer-managed KMS supported for S3 archival."

deploy-bot: POC deployment for bluewave scheduled at 2025-11-03T02:00:00Z.

maria_se: I'll draft the questionnaire response and send to BlueWave procurement. Tagging legal if they want a formal retention addendum.

tyler_poc: Thanks — please cc me and ops so I can validate the forwarder.

devon_sec: Sending the two event snippets and the short mapping to SIG/CAIQ to the folder /shared/sales/bluewave/siem-evidence (we'll export for procurement).

maria_se: Sent to buyer at 2025-11-02T10:05Z. Subject: "BlueWave: SIEM & Audit Trail evidence for vendor review"

maria_se: Marking resolved unless they come back with network or legal asks.
